title: Toggleable World Plugins
description: Adds an easy way to toggle plugin commands for specific worlds of your choice
body:
# Our Discord Community
https://discord.gg/FSydJSAwRx

By Using this plugin and joining the discord you are helping support the developing team and build our community for plugin creation to help motivate us to keep creating what we love to do.

We also love to see plugin idea's and have reccomendations in the discord to please join if you would like to interact and help build out community.

# Main Use
This Plugin is a fully working version of the perworldplugins server plugin for paper. The main idea of this plugin is to easily allow people to enable and disable specific plugins already installed on a server and limit them to specific chosen worlds. so if there is a plugin you want to not work in the overworld at all then you could disable it inside of the configurable gui.

/twpgui - this opens the gui for managing worlds plugins by toggling them on and off /twpinfo - briefly describes what /twpgui and /twpinfo does

# Why Use This?
You should use this plugin because it works for all paper version from 1.21 to 1.21.11 and is currently being tested for the newer 26.1+ versions. This plugin is also being tested for bugs every single week and being logged for fixes, new additions and optimization reworks for future upadates.

this overall is a easier to use and more optimized version of other world plugin toggle addons.

By Using this plugin and joining the discord you are helping support the developing team and build our community for plugin creation to help motivate us to keep creating what we love to do.

# WARNING ⚠️
**This plugin doesn't disable plugin's functions** but only their commands for anyone to use, so if a plugin is disabled in a world then item abilities, textures, functions will all still work but only commands for that plugin will be disabled
